n:
BurstPQS could not find any burst-compiled methods!

This is not a hard error and your game is not broken. It does mean that KSPBurst was unable to successfully build a native library so some things will be much slower than they were meant to be.

For the latest advice on making KSPBurst work take a look at the BurstPQS forum thread.
